about: Gull Geo and the hermit's cell (Book 4 section 02; Book 9 sections 03 and 05; Stage 14, decisions S14-1, S14-5 and S14-39): blocks 4 to 13 by 2 to 10, the island's north-west corner, expanded by src/tools/levels/zones.ts. The narrow geo cuts in from the north between two headlands of heather standing on cliffs, landing N3 at its head of shingle (block (12, 6)); a steep path climbs from the head up its east side to the cell on the neck at block (11, 8), a roofless ring of drystone about 5 tiles across inside with its doorway east, the burned altar against its west wall, the slab with the cross beside the doorway, and the fallen corbel's low gap through its north wall (a crawl). The sea cave in the geo's west wall dries only at low water; across a gully from its mouth, a dry cleft above the storm line, reached by a jump. Edit this plan, not the generated map, then run npm run zones.
